mainEntity.name: Should I hire a painter for touch-ups or do it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: For small repairs, compare whether the contractor is careful about prep, matching, and cleanup rather than only price. A cheaper quote may leave out priming, blending, or texture matching, which can make the repair obvious. The better option is the one that explains exactly how the touch-up will be tested and finished.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY can work for tiny scuffs, but professional help is better when matching, texture, or sheen are important. The key difference is usually prep and blending, not just applying paint.
